meta.name: Barbie and Friends: Monster High
meta.description:
Welcome to Barbie and Friends, where imagination knows no bounds and the magic of play comes to life! Join Barbie and her best doll friends in their glamorous world, where fashion, friendship, and thrilling adventures take center stage!

Shows: Monster High, Barbie Dreamtopia Live !, Barbie Dreamtopia, Enchantimals Tales from Everwilde, Barbie Dream Magic
Available on: Samsung TV Plus
